title: eludite.nuget.uninstall input
description: Uninstall a package (Installed's Uninstall). The project files (or Directory.Packages.props under Central Package Management) are edited with their formatting kept, then restored unless the setting nuget.restoreOnChange is off; a failed restore leaves the edit, with its errors in the answer and the Error List. Class execute under the solution policy's `nuget.change` (agents are asked by default). Every change is audited with the project, the package and the version.

project.description: A project of the open solution: its name (`App`) or the absolute path of its project file.

projects.description: Several projects. Omitted with `project`: every project that references it.
